name: Venaticosuchus
sum: Venaticosuchus is an ornithosuchid pseudosuchian from the Late Triassic Ischigualasto Formation of Argentina.
wsnote: No body-length estimate is given in the sources consulted.
holotype: An incomplete skull and jaw (with a lost partial forelimb and osteoderms) from Cerro Las Lajas, middle Ischigualasto Formation.
material: The holotype only, with later rediscovered cranial material (Von Baczko et al. 2018).
biology: Venaticosuchus and other ornithosuchids were probably specialised scavengers, with meat-eating features but poor adaptations for dealing with living prey.
author: Bonaparte 1970
